# Federal Register

> The Federal Register is the official journal of the federal government, providing public access to federal regulations, notices, and official documents.

The Federal Register, managed by the Office of the Federal Register, serves as the authoritative source for federal regulatory information and government notices. It provides tools for users to search, track, and manage regulatory documents through authenticated user accounts.

## Key Topics

- Office of the Federal Register
- Federal Register
- authentication
- user accounts
- sign-in
- profile management
- account management
- user authentication
- federal regulations
- government notices

## User Account & Authentication

- [Sign In / Sign Up](https://www.federalregister.gov/auth/sign_in): Authentication and sign-in page for Federal Register user accounts
- [Profile Management](https://www.federalregister.gov/my/profile/edit): User profile editing and account management for Federal Register
